name: California
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (2025 certification); WCAG 2.2 AA for certifications after 2025-07-01; Section 508

laws.summary: State entities, and others using state funds, must meet Section 508 for electronic and information technology.
Bars disability discrimination in state-run or state-funded programs and ties to federal accessibility rules.
Each state agency director and CIO must post a signed WCAG AA certification on the homepage every two years.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: CDT PS 029: SIMM 25 IT Web Accessibility Resource Guide and SAM 4833 (April 2025)

applies_to: State agencies and entities; § 7405 also reaches entities using state funds, and § 11135 reaches state-funded programs including local ones.

deadlines.what: Biennial certification against WCAG 2.1 AA; WCAG 2.2 requirements take effect after this date
Next biennial certification (WCAG 2.2 AA per CDT)
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Signed homepage certification by director and CIO every two years (SIMM 25B form optional)
Follow SAM 4833 accessibility policy; exceptions per SAM 4833.1
Contractors must agree to respond to and resolve accessibility complaints (§ 7405)
mobile: implied — SAM/SIMM cover IT generally; the certification is website-focused.
procurement: Contractors of state or local entities for EIT must agree to respond to and resolve accessibility complaints (§ 7405).
enforcement: Nondiscrimination under § 11135; CDT IT Policy Office oversees; public reports go to each agency's listed contact (CA.gov uses info.eservices@state.ca.gov).
notes: § 11546.7 and § 11135 text was not fully read (leginfo page rendered badly); their summaries rely on the CDT announcement. The remedy route under § 11139 was not verified. office_url comes from search results and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.

covers_conditionally.when: Gov. Code § 11135 reaches state-funded programs, including local ones
